records.section_heading: Optimize AI. Build Local. Scale Impact.
records.content: One platform of Apps, Ants and Agents that quietly does the work your team shouldn't have to.
We match each task to the leanest model that does it well — optimized AI, not just more AI — so you get the result without paying for overkill.
Apps, Ants and Agents drop into the tools you already use, so work speeds up from day one — no rip-and-replace, nothing to relearn.

Guardrails, human oversight and audit trails are built in — so you can roll AI out wider with confidence, not risk.
Built for teams like yours
Pick an accelerator on the left — see the pain it removes and what it looks like doing the job.

records.section_heading: AI discovery & interviews, run for you
records.content: The Voice Agent runs the discovery call or first-round interview — asks, listens, scores and books the next step.
The Meeting Bot joins the call, logs each decision and assigns the action items — nothing waits for Friday memory.
Clients text a time; the Scheduling Bot checks availability, books the slot and confirms — no back-and-forth.
Scan an invoice, a form, a deed — Smart Scan pulls out the fields and hands you structured data.
Messages arrive in any language — Multi-Language answers guests in theirs and logs the task in yours.
Forward a PDF, an email, a photo — clean rows land in your spreadsheet or system, typed by no one.
The Ant scans incoming mail, drafts replies in your voice and sends the routine ones — only what needs you reaches you.
The Lead Agent scans the market for businesses that need you right now — scored, with outreach ready to go.

records.section_heading: A chief of staff in your pocket
records.content:
The Personal Agent checks the mail, answers the calls, keeps the calendar — and briefs you on what actually needs you.
Small teams get an always-on back office. Enterprises get scale without headcount. Same platform, no heavy investment.

A3i Accel ("we", "our", "us") respects your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and your rights in relation to that information when you use the Service.

We collect the following categories of information:
Account information: name, email address, hashed password, company, and account type.
Usage data: the agents and features you use, credit balance, timestamps, and a short snippet of your inputs and outputs stored in your account history.
Communications: any messages you send us via the contact form or support email.
Cookies & analytics: we use cookies and analytics tools (such as Google Analytics) only after you grant consent via our cookie banner.
Payment data: if you subscribe to a paid plan, billing is processed by a third-party payment processor. We do not store your full card details.

A3i Accel uses Anthropic's Claude API to generate AI responses. Your inputs to AI agents are transmitted to Anthropic for processing. Anthropic does not use API inputs to train its models. For details, see Anthropic's privacy policy.

If you choose to connect your Google Calendar to NoteTaker, you authorize A3i Accel through Google's OAuth consent screen. We request only the scopes needed for the feature:
Calendar events ( calendar.events ) — to read your upcoming events so you can invite the NoteTaker bot to a meeting with one click, and to create calendar events with a Google Meet link when you schedule a meeting through the Service.
Basic profile ( openid , email ) — to show which Google account is connected.
What we store. We store an encrypted OAuth refresh token so the connection persists between sessions; it is encrypted at rest. We do not sell your Google data, do not use it for advertising, and do not use it to train any AI model. Calendar information is used only to provide the features described above.
Revoking access. You can disconnect at any time from the Calendar page inside NoteTaker (which deletes the stored token), or from your Google Account at myaccount.google.com/permissions .
Limited Use. A3i Accel's use and transfer of information received from Google APIs to any other app will adhere to the Google API Services User Data Policy , including the Limited Use requirements.
If you use our voice-calling features, phone numbers and call audio are processed by Twilio, our telephony provider. Call transcripts may be stored in your account history for your review.

We retain your account data for as long as your account is active. You may request deletion of your account and associated data at any time by contacting us. Some information may be retained for legal, tax, or security reasons.

We use industry-standard security measures including encrypted connections (HTTPS), hashed passwords, and access controls. However, no system is 100% secure. You are responsible for keeping your account credentials safe.
The Service is not directed to children under 16. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If we learn we have collected such information, we will delete it.
Your data may be processed in countries outside your own. We take appropriate safeguards to ensure your data remains protected in line with applicable laws.
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify users of material changes by posting the updated policy on this page and updating the "Last updated" date.
For privacy-related questions or to exercise your rights, contact us via the Contact page .
